status: producer patch prepared; source application validated; compilation and runtime validation pending
integer_encoding: All integral payload values except schema_version are decimal strings; booleans remain JSON booleans. Trace envelope ts/pid/tid use exporter-native types.
ordering: event_seq increases on every instrumentation call, even with category disabled; gaps or missing lifecycle anchors invalidate reconstructed history. Instance IDs are process-local construction sequences, not pointers or wire IDs.
reset_semantics: reset_epoch starts at zero and increases only when the submitter pending counter is reset by context loss or empty submission. GenerateNewSurfaceId emits frame_id.reset without changing reset_epoch. attempt_id is monotonic across resets; entry_epoch is captured once, reset_epoch is current state.
batch_join: Local batch_id values identify only their own producer. Cross-process matching requires independently validated existing Mojo flow linkage and unique enclosing send/receive boundary records; never equal local batch IDs or PTS.

kinds.instance.end: Destruction boundary; no later events from the instance are valid.
kinds.state.before: State before a setter/lifecycle action; cause names the action.
kinds.state.after: State after a setter/lifecycle action; cause names the action.
kinds.frame_id.reset: last-frame ID reset without a pending-count reset; cause=surface_id.
kinds.submit.entry: Attempt entry with current submitter state.
kinds.submit.send: phase=enter/exit brackets application SubmitCompositorFrame, which may enqueue a bundle rather than send IPC.
kinds.submit.return: Exact return reason with current state; output/size fields exist only after original evaluation.
kinds.counter.change: Actual pending-count mutation after submit work or ACK reclaim; cause=submit/ack and attempt_id/callback_id respectively.
kinds.counter.reset: Actual pending-count reset; cause=context_lost/empty_submit, previous_epoch and reset_epoch.
kinds.ack.enter: Submitter callback entry with callback_id and resource_count, before reclaim.
kinds.ack.reclaim_done: Same callback_id after ReclaimResources returns, before pending guard/decrement.
kinds.ack.exit: Same callback_id after decrement or zero-count handling; applied boolean.
kinds.empty.exit: Same empty_id with submitted boolean; actual counter reset is separately recorded.
kinds.bundle.client.add: Client registration boundary with sink IDs and client_address; does not prove successful remote initialization.
kinds.bundle.enqueue: Entry queued for later notification delivery; entry_kind, sink IDs, queue_index/resource_count. FIFO relation must be checked against flush membership.
kinds.bundle.send.enter: Notification IPC call boundary after queue extraction, before method call; counts include zero-ACK batches.
kinds.bundle.send.entry: One ordered ACK/reclaim/begin-frame member of the outgoing call.
kinds.bundle.send.exit: Return from notification IPC method call, not kernel transport completion.
kinds.bundle.receive.enter: Client FlushNotifications entry with counts and local batch_id.
kinds.bundle.receive.entry: Per-member dispatch before callback, or skipped entry with client_found=false.
kinds.bundle.receive.entry_done: Per-member callback return with client_found=true; absent for skipped entries.
kinds.service.admit: Service pending-count increment with sink identity, pending_before/after, frame_token and surface_frame_trace_id; not proof of final SubmitResult acceptance.
kinds.service.ack.ready: Support SendCompositorFrameAck entry; no protocol frame ID is introduced.
kinds.service.ack.emit: Service pending decrement and selected route=ack/reclaim/no_client, with resource count and local callback_id.
kinds.service.ack.done: Return from service notification call for callback_id.
kinds.surface.ack.ready: FrameData first ACK-ready transition before exact client callback, with callback_id, captured frame_token/surface_frame_trace_id/frame_index/client_address/client_present/called. This callback ID is local observation identity.
kinds.frame.prepare.begin: Video-only preparation input unique_frame_id/PTS and decoder_address.
kinds.frame.prepare.end: Video-only preparation input/output identity relation; output_valid=false for cancellation.
kinds.frame.select: Selected VideoFrame unique_frame_id/PTS with compositor_address. Address is not lifetime identity.
kinds.surface.ack.done: Paired surface callback completion using only pre-call captured values, even if FrameData/client was destroyed. Null-client ready/done has called=false.

source_stream_note: These three object kinds use thread-local observation streams, not per-source-object lifetime IDs; addresses are attributes only. Frame unique IDs and explicitly emitted input/output relationships provide frame joins.
validation: No C++ compilation or runtime evidence is asserted by this schema. Missing/duplicate records, category toggles, event loss, reset races, skipped clients and ambiguous nesting remain explicit failures or unresolved joins. Runtime buffer bounds and loss counters are required.
binding_epoch_semantics: Increments at StartSubmitting entry; identifies a new local binding attempt, not remote creation success. Independent of the pending-counter reset epoch.
source_field_note: surface_frame_trace_id is signed int64 frame.metadata.begin_frame_ack.trace_id, with -1 meaning unset, matching pinned CompositorFrameSinkSupport Graphics.Pipeline producer at lines721-734; it is not an ACK protocol frame ID and unset cannot establish trace/flow identity.
